summary.verdict: GENERALIZES (in direction; honest nuance): FBA-essentiality's target enrichment is UNIVERSAL across all 3 bacteria (odds ratio {'ecoli': 18.501, 'mtb': 6.041, 'paeruginosa': 5.824}) — essential genes are drug targets far more often everywhere; and it ADDS BEYOND CONSERVATION in 2/3 + pooled (pooled CV ΔAUROC +0.048, coef_ess +0.296 ≈ cons +0.307). So MET1's mechanistic ceiling-break is NOT E.coli-specific. Honest caveats: effect is MORE MODEST than MET1's curated iML1515 (de-novo CarveMe GEMs on the DEFAULT/complete medium give fewer core-essential genes); P. aeruginosa is the H2 exception (ΔAUROC -0.025, but only 20 targets = underpowered). A genuine, generalizing capability with honest per-organism variance.
